Extremely disappointing experience. I went in for the most basic service possible (just a blowdry) to relax and pamper myself. I naturally have white hair strands, and after I got home, I noticed some of them had literally turned yellow/brassy.

What’s frustrating is that I use heat on my hair almost every single day and this has NEVER happened before. The only difference was my appointment at this salon.

When I contacted them, instead of properly handling the situation or offering any real solution, they immediately became defensive and started blaming me and even blamed an anti-frizz treatment I had done OVER A YEAR AGO. Their “apology” was basically: “this never happened before” and “the technician didn’t use anything.” That’s not accountability. Just because something “never happened before” does not mean it didn’t happen to me. The issue started immediately after my appointment, yet there was zero effort to investigate properly, fix the damage, or make things right.

For a salon that presents itself as high end, the customer service was shockingly dismissive. I left feeling blamed, unheard, and honestly upset over something that should have been a simple relaxing experience.

Would not recommend if you actually care about the condition of your hair or how clients are treated when something goes wrong.

review_text:
I stopped going to this salon several months ago after a painful manicure and pedicure experience where I was injured and resulted in a serious infection. I contacted customer service at the time, but apart from an apology, nothing seemed to change.

I recently decided to give Badasing in Aljada a second chance, but unfortunately I had the exact same technician and the same experience. I booked a simple, regular manicure, yet during the entire appointment she kept trying to upsell me to other services such as gel and Russian manicure, as well as hand oils and creams. Being asked once is understandable, but repeatedly pushing additional services and products throughout the appointment was overwhelming and very frustrating. If I wanted a different service, I would have booked it. If I wanted to buy products, I would have asked for them.

On top of that, she cut my cuticles so aggressively that every single finger was hurt, and several of them started bleeding. I repeatedly told her that it was painful, but she continued in the same way and insisted that my skin was “just sensitive.” A professional manicure should never leave a client with bleeding fingers and unnecessary pain that could easily lead to an infection!

What is most disappointing is that this is the second time this has happened, despite my previous complaint. I gave this salon another chance because I expected they would improve, but unfortunately nothing seems to have changed. I cannot recommend this salon based on my experience, especially to anyone who values proper nail care, professionalism, and respect for the client’s comfort.

review_text:
I have been a loyal customer of Bedashing since its inception, and it was once one of the best nail salons in Abu Dhabi. Unfortunately, the level of service at this branch has significantly declined and has become extremely disappointing.

On more than five occasions, I specifically booked hair services with a particular technician (Lycil) at a confirmed time, only to arrive on time — and often even early — and still be left waiting for over 30 minutes. What is even more frustrating is seeing the same technician begin servicing another client instead of honoring my confirmed appointment. This reflects a complete lack of respect for customers’ time and poor appointment management.

What makes this worse is that raising these concerns with branch management (Julie and Fatima) has resulted in no meaningful action or improvement.

I am also extremely concerned about the integrity of the hair treatments being provided. After receiving a BB Crème treatment, sulfate-containing shampoo was used despite this treatment specifically requiring sulfate-free products to maintain results. This caused the treatment to wear off prematurely. When I raised this issue last year, the branch redid the treatment free of charge — which only confirmed that the mistake should never have happened in the first place. To be clear, the same technician is the one who used sulfate shampoo on my hair again, leaving no room to dismiss this as an innocent oversight.

That said, I would like to acknowledge Retchel, Lalin, and Milarose, who consistently provide excellent nail service and demonstrate professionalism that reflects the standards Bedashing was once known for.

It is disappointing to see such a reputable brand fall short at this branch. I strongly urge higher management to step in, investigate these recurring issues, and restore the quality, professionalism, and customer care that loyal clients have come to expect from Bedashing.

review_text:
If you want your natural nails completely destroyed, go to any Bedashing branch.

I booked an appointment for lash extension removal and soft gel extension removal. Before booking, I specifically asked on WhatsApp whether they knew how to remove soft gel extensions, and they confirmed that they did.

The only positive thing I can say is that the lash removal was done properly.

The nail removal, however, was one of the worst salon experiences I’ve ever had. The technician started by aggressively drilling my nails before applying acetone and foil wraps. When the foils were removed, instead of the product being properly soaked off, she continued filing and drilling my nails, then wrapped them back up in acetone and foil again. This cycle was repeated multiple times.

By the end of the appointment, my natural nails were left paper-thin, weak, damaged, and painful. It genuinely felt like she was drilling away my actual nails rather than removing the product. A professional soft gel removal should not leave someone’s nails in this condition.

What’s even more frustrating is that I specifically checked beforehand that they offered soft gel removal. If this is the standard removal process, then they should not be offering the service at all.

I left with nails that are significantly worse than when I walked in and will now need months to recover. I paid for a removal service, not for my natural nails to be ruined.

The lash removal was good, but the damage done to my nails completely overshadowed any positive part of the visit. I would never trust Bedashing with my nails again and would not recommend their soft gel removal service to anyone.
